title: Mapping Geopolitical Bias in 11 Large Language Models: A Bilingual, Dual-Framing Analysis of U.S.–China Tensions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to seven critical U.S.-China geopolitical topics using bilingual (English and Chinese) and dual-framing (affirmative and reverse) prompts, followed by automated stance detection to score responses on a normalized ideological scale from -2 (strongly Pro-China) to +2 (strongly Pro-U.S.).
